description: Current weather and daily forecast for any place on Earth. Current temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, cloud cover and conditions plus a forecast of up to 9 days (min/max temperature, precipitation, wind) for a city name, address or coordinates. Dates are UTC. Price $0.005 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of place)

place.description: City or address, e.g. Berlin or 1600 Pennsylvania Ave. Not needed when lat and lon are given
